bridge.title: Four things I noticed

beats.title: 419,000 subscribers. Nothing of yours to buy.
beats.text: Your house-price video passed 846,000 views in six days, the newsletter reaches 78,000 readers, and the podcast has guests like Deborah Meaden. But everything you offer is free, and the paid parts belong to someone else: sponsors and broker sign-up bonuses.

beats.title: 18,700 people took your course.
beats.text: Index Funds for Beginners has 18,700 students, and the comments read like thank-you notes: “I just opened my first Vanguard account.” These people already trust you with their first steps, and many will want help with the next ones.

beats.title: After the course, the next step is a broker link.
beats.text: When someone finishes the free course, the path leads to a platform sign-up bonus. The people who want structure, accountability and help building their own plan have nowhere to go with you, so that demand goes elsewhere.

beats.title: “I keep it free on purpose.” Keep it free.
beats.text: The videos, the newsletter and the course stay free, that's the front door. The programme is only for the small share who want to go further with you, and the application keeps it to people who are ready.
beats.quote: “This is the course I wish someone gave me 10 years ago.”

bridge.closing: So instead of explaining it, I built it. The page, the application, the emails and the ads, all below.

mechanism.title: From knowing to doing.
mechanism.body: The free course explains how index funds work. The programme turns that into your own written plan: what you invest in, through which accounts, how much each month, and what you do when the market drops. Eight weeks, in a small group, with Damien.

qualification.title: Apply for the Index Funds Programme

questions.q: Have you taken Index Funds for Beginners?
Where are you with investing right now?
What's the one money decision you keep putting off?
Can you give it about an hour a week for 8 weeks?
Do you understand that investing involves risk and you may get back less than you put in?
If you're accepted, are you ready to invest in the programme now?

notFit.title: Thank you for being honest.
notFit.body: Right now the programme isn't the right next step for you. Start with the free Index Funds for Beginners course and the newsletter, and apply again when you're ready.

finalCta.title: Ready to turn what you know into a plan?
finalCta.body: Apply here. One application, one call, a straight answer.

preCallEmails.subject: You're booked: here's what happens next
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Your call is booked for {{call_time}}. The link is in your calendar invite.

Before we talk:
1. Keep the time free.
2. Have a rough idea of your monthly budget and which accounts you already have (ISA, pension, etc.).

One note: nobody on my team will ever ask you to pay through a DM. Payments only happen through the official links from this email address.

Talk soon,
Damien

preCallEmails.subject: From knowing to doing
preCallEmails.previewText: Why a plan beats one more tip
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Most people who take the free course understand index funds. What they don't have yet is a plan: which accounts, how much, what to do when the market drops.

That's what the programme is for.

On the call we'll look at where you are today.

Damien

preCallEmails.subject: "I already took the free course"
preCallEmails.previewText: Then this is the next step
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Great. That's exactly where the programme starts.

The course gives you the knowledge. The programme gives you eight weeks, a small group and a written plan you actually follow.

If you're not sure you need it, ask on the call. We'll tell you honestly.

Damien

preCallEmails.subject: What we'll cover on the call
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

The call takes about 30 minutes:

1. Where you are now and what you've tried.
2. Where you want to be in a year.
3. How the program works, what it costs, and whether it fits you.

If it isn't a fit, we'll tell you. No pressure either way.

Damien

preCallEmails.subject: Tomorrow: your call with Damien's team
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Quick reminder: your call is tomorrow at {{call_time}}.

If the time doesn't work anymore, reschedule with the link in your invite so someone else can take the slot.

See you tomorrow,
Damien

preCallEmails.subject: Today's the day
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Your call is today at {{call_time}}. Find a quiet spot and have your questions ready.

Talk soon,
Damien
